ai_summary: This document is a routine regulatory filing by 20 Microns Limited, confirming compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, concerning the dematerialisation of securities. It assures that all dematerialisation requests were properly processed, physical certificates cancelled, and depository records updated within the stipulated timeframes by the company's RTA. This indicates sound corporate governance and efficient share registry management, with no red flags identified.
